steps.title: What praevia is
steps.phase: A placenta in the way out
steps.say: The placenta has implanted partly or wholly in the lower uterine segment. In placenta praevia it covers the internal os. A low-lying placenta has its edge less than 20 millimetres from the internal os, after 16 weeks.

steps.title: How common
steps.say: It affects about 1 in 200 pregnancies at term.

steps.title: Risk factors
steps.say: The main risk factor is a previous caesarean section, and the risk rises with each one. Multiparity, maternal age 35 or more, smoking, IVF and multiple pregnancy also raise it.

steps.title: How it presents
steps.say: She has painless, bright red, recurrent vaginal bleeding after 20 weeks. The uterus is soft and non-tender, with a high presenting part or a malpresentation.

steps.title: No finger
steps.say: Never do a digital vaginal examination until praevia has been excluded.

steps.title: Scans
steps.phase: The lower segment grows, so the placenta seems to move
steps.say: Transvaginal ultrasound is safe and the most accurate test. If the placenta is low at the 20-week scan, rescan at 32 weeks, and again at 36 weeks if it persists.

steps.title: Acute bleed
steps.say: For an acute bleed: ABC, two large-bore cannulae, FBC, crossmatch 4 to 6 units, and a CTG. If she is shocked or the bleed is massive, activate the major haemorrhage protocol and do a category 1 caesarean, whatever the gestation.

steps.title: Stable
steps.phase: Expectant care, laid out across the weeks
steps.say: If she is stable, admit her. Give steroids if she is under 34+6 weeks, and anti-D if she is Rh-negative.

steps.title: Planned caesarean
steps.phase: A planned caesarean, planned around the placenta
steps.say: Plan the caesarean at 36+0 to 37+0 weeks, or at 34+0 to 36+6 weeks if she has bled.

steps.title: PPH
steps.phase: Why it keeps bleeding, and how to stop it
steps.say: After delivery she is at risk of postpartum haemorrhage, because the lower segment contracts poorly. Give oxytocin, ergometrine, carboprost and tranexamic acid, then a Bakri balloon.

steps.title: Accreta
steps.say: When the placenta lies over a caesarean scar, think of the placenta accreta spectrum.

overview.say: The placenta lies in the lower segment, over the internal os in placenta praevia.
She has painless, bright red, recurrent bleeding after 20 weeks.
Never do a digital vaginal examination until praevia has been excluded.
A shocked or massive bleed means a category 1 caesarean, whatever the gestation.
Otherwise plan a caesarean at 36+0 to 37+0 weeks.

exam.why: Low-lying means the edge is less than 20 millimetres from the internal os, after 16 weeks.

exam.q: How does the bleeding of placenta praevia present?
exam.why: It is painless, bright red, recurrent vaginal bleeding after 20 weeks.

exam.q: Which examination must you never do until praevia is excluded?
exam.why: Never do a digital vaginal examination until praevia has been excluded.
